newsitem.title: USA: Elk Hills has natgas tender, crude output restored.
newsitem.headline: Elk Hills has natgas tender, crude output restored.

text.p: Elk Hills Naval Petroleum Reserve said Tuesday it will issue a tender for natural gas at 1300 PDT/1600 EDT/2000 GMT, with the results of the bidding due about two hours later.
Separately, crude oil production at Elk Hills is back up at full capacity of around 60,000 barrels per day, according to spokesman Todd Goode.

The field, which is 22 percent owned by Chevron Corp, was hit May 19 when a nearby fire burnt through power lines and cut electricity feeding pumps and other production equipement. Goode said production was restored to normal levels by the end of last week.

The next Elk Hills crude oil tender is scheduled for July, when contracts for 16,100 bpd come up for renewal. The contracts coming around in July are priced against the West Texas Intermediate/Cushing marker and had a life of two months.
The remainder of Elk Hills' crude production is on a six-month contract and sold against posted prices.
